nav.title: Creator studio
nav.notInApp: Open this page in Annulo to read and write data.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Who you are, who you write for, and how you sound. AI follows this when it suggests ideas, writes drafts and rewrites them into posts.

about.label: About me
about.placeholder: What you do, your experience and expertise. Personal stories in drafts only come from here; AI won't make them up

audience.label: Audience
audience.placeholder: Who reads you, what they care about, where they get stuck

pillars.label: Topics
pillars.placeholder: A few kinds of content, one per line, e.g.: AI tools, building in public, book notes

voice.label: Voice
voice.placeholder: How you sound, e.g.: casual, direct, a bit self-deprecating, no exclamation marks

avoid.label: Avoid
avoid.placeholder: Topics you don't touch, things not to say

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.desc: Things to write about: let AI suggest a batch from your profile, or jot your own. Pick one and let AI write the draft.
ideas.noProfile: Your profile is empty, so AI ideas will be generic.
ideas.suggestHint: Watch the assistant on the right; new ideas show up below when it's done.

empty.idea: No ideas to write yet. Let AI suggest some, or add your own.
empty.drafting: No ideas have been drafted yet.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.desc: The master copy of a piece (Markdown). When it's final, turn it into a version for each social account below.
drafts.goIdeas: Go to Ideas and let AI write one
drafts.confirmDeleteHint: Social versions already created are not deleted.
drafts.summaryPlaceholder: A one or two sentence summary
drafts.urlPlaceholder: Link to the original (blog, newsletter; optional)
drafts.revisePlaceholder: What to change, e.g.: a punchier opening, cut to 800 words (leave empty for a general pass)
drafts.saveFirst: Save your edits before asking AI to revise.

dist.title: Post to social media
dist.desc: Pick accounts and AI writes a version for each, following each platform's instructions. Publish or schedule after review.
dist.noPlugin: Posting needs the social plugin, which this project hasn't installed: install social in Settings → Project → Plugins.
dist.needBody: The draft has no body yet
dist.needVideo: This platform only takes videos: edit this version and add a video URL.
dist.confirmPurge: Delete this version? Only the record is deleted; nothing changes on the platform.

accounts.title: Accounts & data
accounts.desc: Social accounts log in with this computer's browser, and the login stays on this computer. Data is collected every 6 hours.
accounts.noPlugin: Social accounts are managed by the social plugin, which this project hasn't installed: install social in Settings → Project → Plugins.
accounts.loginHint: A browser window opens; log in to your account there and it's added automatically.
accounts.healthExpired: The login expired: click "Log in again".
accounts.healthBroken: {op} fails at "{step}"; the platform may have changed:

task.requirementsHint: AI follows these instructions. Changes apply from the next run.
task.requirementsCustom: This is your edited version; you can restore the default.
